001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.sd;

003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseEventIntel;

006import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.events.BaseOneTimeFactor;

010
011public class SDRTestAchillesFactor extends BaseOneTimeFactor {
012        
013        public SDRTestAchillesFactor() {
014                super(Global.getSector().getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getInt("$DEV_sdrAchillesPoints"));
015        }
016
017        @Override
018        public String getDesc(BaseEventIntel intel) {
019                return "Achilles test factor";
020        }
021
022        @Override
023        public TooltipCreator getMainRowTooltip(BaseEventIntel intel) {
024                return new BaseFactorTooltip() {
025                        @Override
026                        public void createTooltip(TooltipMakerAPI tooltip, boolean expanded, Object tooltipParam) {
027                                tooltip.addPara("One-time test factor to advance Achilles' victory.",
028                                                0f, Misc.getHighlightColor(), "Achilles'");
029                        }
030                        
031                };
032        }
033        
034}
